#### analyse population-average predictions

```{r}

pred_mod <- m9c
fitDat <- insight::get_data(pred_mod)
vc <- vcov(pred_mod, type="bias-corrected")

n_sweep  <- 25

x_main    <- "Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl"

x_sweep <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               max(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               length.out=25)

transform_dAnnoy <- \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')


m9cpred <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                              variables = list(Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl=x_sweep),
                                                  by=c("Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl"),
                                                  vcov=vc,
                                                  transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmbScaling)


m9cpredEvt <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                              variables = list(Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl=x_sweep),
                                                  by=c("Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl", "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vc,
                                                  transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmbScaling)



q_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)            # quantiles used for "low / mid / high" slices

# sqm 3
sqm3 <- "UASRoughECMA10ExStd"
sqm3_orig <- subjDataNoAmbScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmbScaling$new_variable == sqm3]
sqm3_q <- unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm3]], q_levels))
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep, 
  sqm3_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm3))

m9cpredR <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = grid_vars,
                                by=c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                                vcov=vc,
                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmbScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c(names(grid_vars)[-1], sqm3_orig)),
      ~ num_factor(.x, digits=2)
    ))

```

## All metrics

### model 10 formula

```{r}

m10formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  PartSharpvBSHMPowAvgStd + PartTonLdSHMPowAvgStd +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + dFluctOV10ExStd + dRoughECMA05ExStd

m10bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  PartSharpvBSHMPowAvgStd + dTonalECMAAvgStd +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgStd + dFluctOV10ExStd + dRoughECMA05ExStd


m10Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m10bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m10formula, data=m10Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m10bformula, data=m10bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m10 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10formula, data=m10Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m10b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10bformula, data=m10bData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m10, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m10b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3c, m4, m5d, m6, m7c,
                    m8, m9c, m10, m10b)

m10_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                        direction="reverse",
                                                        squeeze="none"),
                  workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                direction="reverse", squeeze="none"))

m10b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                        direction="reverse",
                                                        squeeze="none"),
                  workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                direction="reverse", squeeze="none"))

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3c=m3c_cv, m4=m4_cv, m5d=m5d_cv,
                        m6=m6_cv, m7c=m7c_cv, m8=m8_cv, m9c=m9c_cv, m10=m10_cv, m10b=m10b_cv))

```

### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m10bpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m10b, newdata=na.omit(m10bData),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m10b, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - m10bpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m10bpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m10bpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)


if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_DetdSQCal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### test model interactions

#### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m10b,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m10bformula
modelStep$final

```

### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m10bformula, data = m10bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m10bformula, data=m10bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m10bData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m10c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-10, nlambda = 500)

coef(m10c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m10c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m10c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m10c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m10c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m10c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m10c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

 
if (saveplots){
    
  filename <- "dAnnoyMn_PredMod_DetdSQ_glmnetQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

# Change in highly annoyed

## Benchmark categorical variables
(there is no model 11, we just jump to model 12 for convenience)
### model 12 formula

```{r}
# the interaction term between LAE and AmbientVariant caused numerical problems 
m12formula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ 1 + TrialNumberStd + AmbientVariant +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents)))


m12Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m12formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))

m12bformula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ 1 + TrialNumberStd + AmbientEnvCore*I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents))) +
  AmbientEnvCore*UASOperation + AmbientEnvCore*UASType + UASType*I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents))) +
  AmbientVariant + UASProximity + UASStart

m12bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m12bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))


# include personal factors
m12cformula <- update(m12formula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl +
                       Area_soundscape2)

m12cData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m12cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))

m12dformula <- update(m12bformula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl +
                       Area_soundscape2)

m12dData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m12dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))

```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m12formula, data=m12Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12bformula, data=m12bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12cformula, data=m12cData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12dformula, data=m12dData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}


m12 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12formula, data=m12Data,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12bformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12cformula, data=m12cData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='ar(1)-dependent')

m12d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12dformula, data=m12dData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m12, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

### analyse performance

```{r}
geeModelPerformance(m12, m12)

m12_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,
                    seed=cv_seed, data=m12Data, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE, workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m12b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,

                     return_predictions=TRUE, workers=n_cores) |>

m12c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,
                     seed=cv_seed, data=m12cData, agg_cols="StimID",
                     return_predictions=TRUE, workers=n_cores) |>

m12d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12d, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds,
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
arm::binnedplot(fitted(m12), m12.resP)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
```

### test model interactions

#### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m12,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m12formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m12formula, data = m12Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m12formula, data=m12Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m12Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m12e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-8, nlambda = 500)

coef(m12e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m12e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m12e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m12e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m12e$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m12e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m12e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m12predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=na.omit(m12Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents",
                                           "AmbientEnvCore",
                                           "AmbientVariant"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m12, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp -
                      m12predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp -
                                                       mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m12predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighlyAnnoyedProp', measured_ci_low='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m12predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(BSS == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dHiAnnoy_PredMod_BlineCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

## UAS info only

### LAE only with events

#### model 13 formula

```{r}

m13formula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents)))

m13Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m13formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m13formula, data=m13Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m13 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m13formula, data=m13Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m13, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m13.resP <- residuals(m13, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE)

used <- complete.cases(m13Data[all.vars(m13formula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m13), m13.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m13Data$UASLAEMaxLRScl[used], residuals(m13, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASLAEMaxLRScl")
arm::binnedplot(m13Data$UASEvents[used], residuals(m13, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASEvents")
arm::binnedplot(m13Data$TrialNumberStd[used], residuals(m13, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "TrialNumberStd")

m13.resM <- residuals(m13, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m13,
                    clusterVar=m13.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m13.Cook <- cooks.distance(m13, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m13, clusterVar=m13.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m13)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13)

m13_cv <- cv_glmgee(m13, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m13Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m13predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m13, newdata=na.omit(m13Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m13, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - m13predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m13predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighlyAnnoyedProp', measured_ci_low='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m13predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.9)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.7, label=deparse(bquote(BSS == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.65, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.6, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "dHiAnnoy_PredMod_LAECal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 14 formula

```{r}

m14formula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl +
  I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents))) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
  UASFluctOV10ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd

m14Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m14formula)), drop=FALSE]

m14bformula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl + 
  I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents))) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
  UASFluctOV10ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd

m14bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m14bformula)), drop=FALSE]

m14cformula <- update(m14formula, . ~ . + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents))))

m14dformula <- update(m14bformula, . ~ . + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents))))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m14formula, data=m14Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14bformula, data=m14bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14cformula, data=m14Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14dformula, data=m14bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m14 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14formula, data=m14Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14bformula, data=m14bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14cformula, data=m14Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14dformula, data=m14bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m14, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14, m14b, m14c, m14d)

nd <- na.omit(m14Data)
ndb <- na.omit(m14bData)

m14_cv <- cv_glmgee(m14, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m14b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m14b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m14c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m14c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m14d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m14d, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14=m14_cv, m14b=m14b_cv,
                        m14c=m14c_cv, m14d=m14d_cv))

```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
used <- complete.cases(m14bData[all.vars(m14dformula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m14d), m14d.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m14bData$UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl[used], residuals(m14d, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl")
arm::binnedplot(m14bData$UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd[used], residuals(m14d, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd")
arm::binnedplot(m14bData$UASTonalECMA05ExStd[used], residuals(m14d, type = "pearson"),

arm::binnedplot(m14bData$UASSharpvBISO105ExStd[used], residuals(m14d, type = "pearson"),

arm::binnedplot(m14bData$UASRoughDW10ExStd[used], residuals(m14d, type = "pearson"),
```

```{r}
m14dformula
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m14dformula, data = m14bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m14dformula, data=m14bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m14bData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m14e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m14e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m14e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m14e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14e$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


```

```{r}
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m15b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m15b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m15b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m15b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m15_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m15,
                                 centred_vars = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl = "UASLAEMaxLR"),
                                 scaling_data = subjDataNoAmb,
                                 TrialNumberStd=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### full SQ model

#### model 16 formula

```{r}

m16formula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*AmbientEnvCore + 
  UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents))) +
  UASTonalECMA05ExStd + UASSharpvBISO105ExStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd +
  UASFluctOV10ExStd + UASRoughDW10ExStd

m16Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m16formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m16formula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m16 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16formula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m16, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14f, m15, m16)

nd <- na.omit(m16Data)

m16_cv <- cv_glmgee(m16, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14f=m14f_cv, m15=m15_cv, m16=m16_cv))

```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
used <- complete.cases(m16Data[all.vars(m16formula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m16), m16.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m16Data$UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl[used], residuals(m16, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASLAF50ExMaxLRScl")
arm::binnedplot(m16Data$UASImpulsLoudWZAvgStd[used], residuals(m16, type = "pearson"),
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m16,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m16formula

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m16formula, data = m16Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m16formula, data=m16Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m16Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m16b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-8, nlambda = 500)

coef(m16b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m16b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m16b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


```

#### fit elastic net-informed model

```{r}
m16cformula <- update(m16formula, . ~ . - UASTonalECMA05ExStd - UASSharpvBISO105ExStd - UASRoughDW10ExStd - UASFluctOV10ExStd)
```

```{r}

m16c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16cformula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),

                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m16c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

```{r}
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>

compare_cv_results(list(m16=m16_cv, m16c=m16c_cv))
```

## UAS-env difference

### LAeqLAF10diff with events

#### model 17 formula

```{r}

m17formula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ TrialNumberStd + LAeqLAF10diffScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents)))

m17bformula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ TrialNumberStd + LAeqdiffScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - log10(mean(UASEvents)))

m17Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m17formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))

m17bData <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m17bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighlyAnnoyed))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m17formula, data=m17Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m17bformula, data=m17bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m17 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17formula, data=m17Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m17b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17bformula, data=m17bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m17, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m17b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14f, m15, m16c, m17, m17b)

m17_cv <- cv_glmgee(m17, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m17Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m17b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m17b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m17bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14f=m14f_cv,
                        m15=m15_cv, m16c=m16c_cv,
                        m17=m17_cv, m17b=m17b_cv))

```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m17,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m17formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m17formula, data = m17Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m17formula, data=m17Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m17Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m17c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-100, nlambda = 500)

coef(m17c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m17c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m17c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m17c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m17c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m17c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m17c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m18,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m18formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m18formula, data = m18Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m18formula, data=m18Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m18Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m18b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-100, nlambda = 500)

coef(m18b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m18b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m18b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

if (saveplots){

  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_dLAESQ_glmnetQb"
 
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

##### fit elastic net-informed model

###### formula

```{r}

m18cformula <- update(m18formula, . ~ . - LAELAeqdiffScl:I(log10(UASEvents)))

```

###### run model

####### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m18cformula, data=m18Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

###### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m18c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m18cformula, data=m18Data,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m18c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

###### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m18c.resP <- residuals(m18c, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE)

used <- complete.cases(m18Data[all.vars(m18cformula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m18c), m18c.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m18Data$UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd[used], residuals(m18c, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd")
arm::binnedplot(m18Data$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd[used], residuals(m18c, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd")
arm::binnedplot(m18Data$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRStd[used], residuals(m18c, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRStd")
arm::binnedplot(m18Data$UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd[used], residuals(m18c, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd")
arm::binnedplot(m18Data$UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd[used], residuals(m18c, type = "pearson"),

arm::binnedplot(m18Data$UASEvents[used], residuals(m18c, type = "pearson"),

m18c.resM <- residuals(m18c, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m18c,

glmgee_vif(m18c)
```

###### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m18cpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m18c, newdata=na.omit(m18Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m18c, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - m18cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m18cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighlyAnnoyedProp', measured_ci_low='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m18cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(BSS == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){

}
```

## UAS all metrics

### model 19 formula

```{r}

m19formula <- dHighlyAnnoyed ~ TrialNumberStd + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd + dSharpAurSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd*UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd + dRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd

m19Data <- subjDataNoAmb[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19formula)), drop=FALSE]

```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m19formula, data=m19Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m19 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19formula, data=m19Data,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m19, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14b, m15, m16b, m17, m18, m19)

m19_cv <- cv_glmgee(m19, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m19Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
```

```{r}
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m19formula, data = m19Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m19formula, data=m19Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m19Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m19b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-120, nlambda = 5000)

coef(m19b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m19b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m19b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_AllSQEnvL_glmnetQb"
 
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

```{r}
m19c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19cformula, data=m19Data,
```

```{r}
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(BSS == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_AllSQnetCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

## Comparison between GEE-PA and GLMM-SS models with LAE predictor

### Timing comparison

```{r}

set.seed(808)

newData <- data.frame(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(-12, 13, by=1), UASEvents=1,
                      TrialNumberStd=mean(subjDataNoAmb$TrialNumberStd))

# benchmark timing
testdHA <- microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  
    'GLMM_model' = {m0GLMM <- lme4::glmer(dHighlyAnnoyed ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                                              TrialNumberStd +
                                                (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) | ID),
                                                  data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                              control=glmerctrl)},
    
    'GEE_model' = {m0GEEGLM <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(dHighlyAnnoyed ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                                              TrialNumberStd,
                                                data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                                id=ID, corstr='exchangeable')},
    
    'GLMM_metrics' = {
                        PCP <- glmmPCP(m0GLMM)
                        cbind(performance::model_performance(m0GLMM,
                                                             metrics=c("MSE",
                                                                       "RMSE",
                                                                       "MAE",
                                                                       "AIC",
                                                                       "AICc",
                                                                       "BIC",
                                                                       "R2",
                                                                       "LOGLOSS")),
                                    PCP)
                        },
    
    'GEE_metrics' = {geeModelPerformance(m0GEEGLM, verbose=FALSE)},
    
    'GLMM_prediction' = {m0GLMMpredict <- ggeffects::predict_response(m0GLMM,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "TrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                       bias_correction=TRUE)},
    
    'GEE_prediction' = {m0GEEGLMpredict <- ggeffects::predict_response(m0GEEGLM,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "TrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                      vcov=vcov(m0GEEGLM, type="bias-corrected"))},
    times=10, unit='s', control=list(order='inorder'))

testdHA

glmmVsGEEdHA <- data.frame(model=summary(testdHA)[1,]$median/summary(testdHA)[2,]$median,
                          metrics=summary(testdHA)[3,]$median/summary(testdHA)[4,]$median,
                          pred=summary(testdHA)[5,]$median/summary(testdHA)[6,]$median,
                          total=sum(summary(testdHA)[1,]$median, summary(testdHA)[3,]$median, summary(testdHA)[5,]$median)/
                                sum(summary(testdHA)[2,]$median, summary(testdHA)[4,]$median, summary(testdHA)[6,]$median))

print(paste("Model:", glmmVsGEEdHA$model))
print(paste("Metrics:", glmmVsGEEdHA$metrics))
print(paste("Prediction:", glmmVsGEEdHA$pred))
print(paste("Total:", glmmVsGEEdHA$total))

ggplot2::autoplot(testdHA)
boxplot(testdHA)


```

### Plot comparison

```{r}

set.seed(808)

UASLAEMaxLRDummy <- seq(-12, 33, by=1) + (max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR) -
                                            max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl))

newData <- data.frame(UASLAEMaxLR=UASLAEMaxLRDummy,
                      UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(-12, 33, by=1), UASEvents=1,
                      TrialNumberStd=0)

mGLMM <- lme4::glmer(dHighlyAnnoyed ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                             TrialNumberStd +
                           (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl | ID),
                            data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         control=glmerctrl)

mGEEGLM <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(dHighlyAnnoyed ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                                              TrialNumberStd,
                                  data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                  id=ID, corstr='exchangeable')

mGLMMpred <- modelbased::estimate_expectation(mGLMM,
                                            data = newData,
                                            predict = "expectation",
                                            ci = 0.95,
                                            keep_iterations = FALSE,
                                            ci_method='wald')

mGLMMpredmarginal <- ggeffects::predict_response(mGLMM,
                                               terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [-12:33]",
                                                "UASEvents [1]",
                                                "TrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                               type='fixed', margin='empirical',
                                               bias_correction=TRUE)

mGEEGLMpred <- ggeffects::predict_response(mGEEGLM,
                                          terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [-12:33]",
                                                  "UASEvents [1]",
                                                  "TrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                           type='fixed', margin='empirical',
                                          vcov=vcov(mGEEGLM, type="bias-corrected"))

mGLMMpredAll <- ggeffects::predict_response(mGLMM,
                                          terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [-12:33]",
                                                  "ID [all]",
                                                  "UASEvents [1]",
                                                  "TrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                           type='random',
                                           bias_correction=FALSE)

p <- ggplot() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1.35,
  text = element_text(family = "serif"),
  plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "cm"),
  axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=11))


for (id in unique(mGLMMpredAll$group)){
  p <- p + geom_line(data=mGLMMpredAll[mGLMMpredAll$group==id,],
                     mapping=aes(x=x, y=predicted, colour="GLMM (CS)"),
                     alpha=0.1, linewidth=0.25)
}

p1 <- p +
  
    geom_ribbon(data=mGLMMpred,
                mapping=aes(x=UASLAEMaxLRScl, ymin=CI_low, ymax=CI_high,
                            colour="GLMM (CS)"),
                alpha=0.5, fill=NA, linetype=3, linewidth=0.55) +
    
    geom_ribbon(data=mGEEGLMpred,
                mapping=aes(x=x, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high,
                            colour="GEE-GLM (PA)"),
                alpha=0.5, fill=NA, linetype=4, linewidth=0.55) +
    
    geom_line(data=mGLMMpred, mapping=aes(x=UASLAEMaxLRScl,
                y=Predicted,
            colour="GLMM (CS)"), linewidth=1) +
    
    geom_line(data=mGEEGLMpred, aes(x=x, y=predicted,
              colour="GEE-GLM (PA)"), linewidth=1) +
  
    geom_line(data=mGLMMpredmarginal, mapping=aes(x=x,
                  y=predicted,
              colour="GLMM (PA)"),
              linetype=2, linewidth=1, alpha=0.75) +
  
    geom_vline(xintercept=max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR) - lae_centre, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR) - lae_centre - 2.5, y = 0.75, 
             label = "Dataset upper limit", color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +

    
    scale_orig("UASLAEMaxLRScl", subjDataNoAmbScaling, by = 5, digits = 0) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 1)) +
    
    scale_colour_manual(values=c("GLMM (CS)"=mycolours[3],
                                 "GEE-GLM (PA)"=mycolours[4],
                                "GLMM (PA)"=mycolours[6]),
                        breaks=c("GLMM (PA)",
                                 "GEE-GLM (PA)",
                                 "GLMM (CS)")) +
    guides(colour=guide_legend(title="Method", reverse=TRUE),
           fill=guide_legend(title="Method", reverse=TRUE)) +
    
    labs(x=expression(paste(UAS~italic(L)[AE],",",~dB)),
         y=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb])))

p1
```
